list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation lists them (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden). Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are this entry's own words, each citing the guide it was drawn from.

trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so it is the last trophy you will pop. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed — every trophy is offline single-player. Just work through the roadmap below and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3 begins (Welcome to Vice City).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life).
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 4 ends, after its final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the final mission of the game.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story — progress made during the story already counts. The bar is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, any 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 of the 397 stunts, 200 of the 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything is still doable in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix the categories however you like, and the flights under bridges are the quickest. Track progress in Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration and then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going after this one pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them in Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most come naturally while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one on its own.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The challenges themselves are not considered hard, and the cited guide links a range-by-range walkthrough for the gold medals if you get stuck on one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). The cited guide links a location-by-location walkthrough for every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win any 20 different races. The cited guide links all 40 unique race locations, so pick the 20 that suit you and work through them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all levels of one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable at the TV at home, and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of a game once — beating every challenge inside it is not required. Pick whichever game you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 you get a call from Andy, then her home address in Belville. Finish her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them are still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams: he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared — find the underwater treasures (purple chest icons, and the metal detector helps dig them up) and bring them back to him. Kenton is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable. Track it in Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them are still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Many questlines do NOT count toward this one — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not counted as strangers. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more strangers still being confirmed. All of them are still there after the story in free-roam, and the trophy list itself tracks how many you have done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is wanted, then drive it back to his garage in west Vice City. Good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go there and destroy them (quest Take Out Kitty Litter). Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, which pops the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, tracked in Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It is still unconfirmed whether that one is required for the trophy, but do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's Jason-only questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you to meet him in Lummox County (quest Veteran Hunted). He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots on the map — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed, so work through his 15 Target Decks (needed for 100% anyway) and it should unlock along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. The cited guide links all 18 set locations, so pick the three easiest sets to finish.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots by holding Up and R1 on a landmark, curiosity or sculpture. There are more than 100 in the world, so any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and more.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (10 groups of 10). The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one pops on the way there. View and track them in Progress, then Challenges, and pick the easiest ones left for last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible once both characters can free-roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with Right and Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). The easiest escape is to drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break), rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while keeping your wanted level — loot the shops without losing the cops. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop, so keep going to a 4th shop if it has not popped. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are a good spot: rob items in each, crack the safe with sticky bombs, and leave before the police arrive.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing cars — just stand on a busy road and scan them; you do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals in Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm). It slows time and drains the purple focus bar, so buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline to extend it, then line up 5 enemies — gang operations are a good spot — and do not miss. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best, and body armor from an Ammu-Nation helps you get close. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; you will likely reach Focus level 4 naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the planes on the airfield do not count. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport for the delayed pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm, then leave undetected. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner to carry a bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal (That's Where The Money Is…): robbing the large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier — block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. Fastest with a plane: fly over every black-fogged part of the map until it is all visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (39 operations in total; the 100% checklist needs all 39). They show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang in Progress, then Gangs — it shows how many of their operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Only this specific blue Banshee counts — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The pop is slightly delayed, after you drive further away on the street.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, also the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling) and take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it up with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so come back later for what is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength). Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at a fitness club — always bring your partner along (call with Right and Triangle) so both train at once. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile (view the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list). Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile) to see a demon face whenever an action counts. Robberies, stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitations and kills all count, and it mostly pops on its own while doing everything else. If it is last, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but a Psycho or Irredeemable profile makes cops shoot on sight.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method unconfirmed as of launch week. The cited guide lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (in Little Cuba, Vice City), possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. Check the cited guide for updates before chasing it — do not trust a method you read anywhere else until a second guide confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods next to it to find the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky), approach it, and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative across robberies, not in one go. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, since they are the most expensive.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total). They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to fund them.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app (installed after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) for parking spots. Moses initially only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
